name: game-vat-baker
description: Dev-only tooling: bakes Mixamo/Adobe .glb skeletal clips into static geometry + quantized Vertex Animation Texture (VAT) files for the crowd-runner mini-games. Not shipped to the bot itself — only its .bin/.json output under assets/game/ ships.

scripts.bake:soldier: node bake_vat.mjs Soldier.glb soldier --clip Run:24 --clip Idle:16
